title: Serious Woman Holding Toddler Outdoors, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor portrait showing a mature woman with styled dark hair holding a small child dressed in a light-colored coat and booties. They stand on a sunny lawn in front of leafy foliage beneath the deep shadow of an architectural roof overhang. The candid framing and direct expressions capture everyday domestic family life during the World War II era.
